events.label: Wedding day; Nyles already looping
events.description: Nyles gives a drunk, rambling toast at a Palm Springs wedding - but he has already lived this exact day countless times, and it never ends.

events.label: Sarah pulled into time cave with Nyles
events.description: Nyles stumbles wounded into a strange glowing cave, and Sarah, the bride's sister, follows him in - which drags her into the same repeating day.

events.label: Sarah wakes looping too
events.description: Sarah wakes on the morning of the wedding all over again, and slowly realises she is now stuck living the same day as Nyles, forever.

events.label: Roy tortures Nyles across loops
events.description: Roy, a wedding guest Nyles wronged, is also trapped in the repeating day and takes it out on Nyles - killing him again and again out of spite.

events.label: Quantum cave / bomb-exit theory
events.description: Sarah refuses to give up on getting out. She studies how the cave works and decides that stepping into it at the exact moment of an explosion might break the loop.

events.label: Enter cave with explosives together
events.description: Nyles and Sarah haul explosives into the glowing cave and hold hands, ready to blow themselves up on the off-chance it frees them.

events.label: Wake Nov 10 — loop broken
events.description: The gamble pays off: Sarah wakes on a normal November morning with no wedding in sight, and Nyles beside her. The repeating day is finally over.

events.label: Morning after; choose each other forward
events.description: Free of the loop for good, Nyles and Sarah relax by a pool in ordinary time and commit to actually building a life together.

events.label: Sarah pulled into wedding loop
events.description: Following Nyles into the mysterious cave traps Sarah inside the wedding day that has already been repeating for him.

events.label: Roy revenge/truce arc
events.description: Roy, another man stuck in the loop, spends his endless days hunting Nyles down before the two men finally call a truce.

events.label: Cave explosion exit to Nov 10
events.description: Sarah's long-shot plan works: setting off an explosion inside the cave at just the right moment spits both of them out into the day after the wedding.

events.label: Nyles trapped at wedding day loop
events.description: Nyles is caught reliving the same wedding day at a Palm Springs resort over and over, and has stopped caring what happens to anyone, including himself.

events.label: Sarah follows Nyles into glowing cave
events.description: After a flirty night together, Sarah chases Nyles into a glowing cave in the hills and is caught in the same endless day as he is.

events.label: Sarah wakes in loop with Nyles
events.description: Sarah wakes to the wedding morning starting again, and the horror sinks in: she and Nyles are both stuck here with no way out.

events.label: Roy (older looper) seeks revenge for being pulled in
events.description: Roy is an older guest who got trapped in the repeating day while trying to catch Nyles, who had slept with his wife. He takes furious revenge on Nyles whenever he can.

events.label: Nyles/Sarah romance and fights inside loop
events.description: With nothing but time, Nyles and Sarah fall for each other - though their fights about honesty and hope keep breaking the romance apart.

events.label: Sarah's guilt over sister's fiancé
events.description: Sarah is haunted by having slept with her sister's fiancé on the eve of the wedding, and being stuck in the day does nothing to ease her shame.

events.label: Couple experiments with loop rules
events.description: The pair treat the loop like a science project, testing its rules - whether people remember, how far they can go, what kills them - to learn what might end it.

events.label: Roy truce / explanation
events.description: Roy finally sits down with Nyles and Sarah, hears their side, and lets go of his vendetta, explaining how he too got pulled into the endless day.

events.label: Sarah builds cave bomb exit hypothesis
events.description: Sarah works out that the cave connects to the repeating day, so walking into it at the moment of an explosion might be the one way out.

events.label: Both enter cave; blast at right moment
events.description: At the climax of the wedding-day fireworks, Nyles and Sarah enter the cave together as the bomb goes off, betting both their lives on Sarah's theory.

events.label: Wake November 10 — loop broken
events.description: Sarah wakes on the 10th of November - a date she has never lived before - and finds Nyles waiting. The trap has sprung open.

events.label: Together in ordinary time
events.description: Out of the loop at last, the two choose to face normal, forward-moving life as a couple instead of going their separate ways.

ruleEffects.effect: Shared cave death/blast satisfies exit for both

outcome.summary: Shared wedding-day loop broken via cave blast; Nyles and Sarah continue into Nov 10.
